testCases.description: Validates complex execution with multiple impulses and tasks

steps: 1. Execute real activity on devbob.metabob.local using kubectl
3. Query SurrealDB directly to capture ground truth data (activity_executions + task_execution tables)
6. Extract displayed data from UI using Playwright selectors
7. Compare UI values against SurrealDB ground truth
8. Expand row to show detailed breakdown
9. Extract task data, impulse data, error messages from expanded view
12. Return PASS/FAIL with detailed check results
validationChecks: Impulse usage display matches execution data

Activity templates available on devbob (add-rest-endpoint, fix-bug-with-validation, etc.)
